card: This pull request opts seven functional tests into immediate transaction relay via noban_tx_relay and ensures three tests preserve whitelist arguments across node restarts. Functional tests not testing relay delays can intermittently time out due to inbound Poisson relay delays, an issue tracked in #19732. Under a test reproducer with forced relay delays, the author observed runtimes dropping from ~60-74 seconds down to 3-14 seconds without timing out. The change touches only test scripts and has no PR dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No changes to commits or diff since the previous description.
evidence: Addresses intermittent test timeouts tracked in issue #19732 ('qa: Functional tests are intrinsically vulnerable to timeouts').

Author reports that under a reproducer forcing a 12-minute relay delay, all nine tests pass and execution time dropped significantly (e.g., wallet_change_address from 62 s to 3 s, wallet_balance from 66 s to 6 s, rpc_psbt from 74 s to 14 s).
problem: Functional tests that do not exercise transaction relay timing can fail intermittently due to timeouts caused by Poisson-delayed relay to inbound peers. Furthermore, certain tests that already used or needed the whitelist dropped it upon restarting nodes with explicit argument lists, reintroducing relay delays.

risk.why: Only touches functional tests; a mistake would at worst cause false test failures in CI.

scope_notes: Small, purely functional test changes touching nine test scripts.
summary: Opts seven functional tests into immediate transaction relay by setting `noban_tx_relay = True`, which whitelists the test peer to bypass Poisson transaction relay delays. It also updates three tests so node restarts preserve `self.extra_args` rather than overwriting arguments and dropping the immediate-relay whitelist.
